focus: Eight tier-2 verdicts: whether the missing tooltip earns its place, and what daily-range's tooltip must reveal

graphEvents.label: Does the missing tooltip earn its place on the seven tier-2 forms?
geometry-only value means needs pointer; all values printed means terminal
parallel-axes terminal: native titles on every dot, lines named at ends
stacked-bars needs tooltip: sub-22-unit segment values geometry-only
stacked-area needs tooltip: band values and total exist only as thickness
grouped-bars needs tooltip: column values geometry-only above a printed ladder
bar-line-composed needs tooltip: shared gridlines make off-scale readings ambiguous
daily-line needs tooltip: 27 of 28 dots are position-only
waterfall terminal: native titles per bar plus printed deltas
daily-range tooltip must reveal low and high, never a midpoint

label: parallel-axes: legend/dim terminal — every dot native-titled (parallel-axes.html:299), lines named at ends (:151), bounds printed (:284-285)
stacked-bars: needs tooltip — segment values under 22 units exist only as height (stacked-bars.html:333 gate); no tick ladder in the file
stacked-area: needs tooltip — band values and total are thickness-only (stacked-area.html:344); Total exists only in the table (:421)
grouped-bars: needs tooltip — column values are y(v) geometry, nothing printed (grouped-bars.html:340)
bar-line-composed: needs tooltip — shared gridlines across two ladders make off-scale readings ambiguous (bar-line-composed.html:384, :416)
daily-line: needs tooltip — the low is the only printed value, 27 of 28 dots position-only (daily-line.html:380)
waterfall: legend/dim terminal — native title per bar (waterfall.html:315-318) plus printed deltas (:320)
daily-range: needs tooltip must reveal that day's low and high, never a midpoint (daily-range.html:264)
two tier-2 forms already ship native SVG titles on marks (parallel-axes, waterfall); tier-2 is not uniformly silent
